about: Spec 032 P6: /fix on dm-tools saves (the DM-with-tools engine). Four complaints from the head-to-head runs (B/C saves: Kazain, the bowl, afternoon, worn), the pinned complaint traced in spec032-investigation/pinned-trace.md (save 175211), and four made-up ones (a clue on record, a DM-made person, an OFFER title, a condition the passage contradicts). Labelled before any live run. Each runs through the dm-tools /fix turn (`play_dispute` routed to `play_dm_dispute`) on its save cut back to just before the report.

items.kind: saved: narration slip about a person's place
items.report: Magby's last line says Kazain "has not yet come down from the stairs", but he never went upstairs. He is still at his table with the ledger and only told me to come up later.

complaints.why: the DM's passage slipped; nothing on record has Kazain go up

items.kind: saved: an NPC ignores what the player did
items.report: Tobbo tells me to take the bowl up to Agnes, but I already brought her the bread and broth and sat with her. He also says "I will pay for the bread and the broth" as if I hadn't yet.

complaints.why: turn.6-8 the PC delivered the food; turn.9's line ignores it

items.report: The result line says "Changed: your opponent worn" which is cut off or garbled. It should say what changed, like Milby being hurt or worn down.

complaints.why: the record is right (Milby worn); the line is clumsy

items.report: The passage says the afternoon light won't hold for long, but the game's clock says it's still the morning of day 1. Which is it?

complaints.why: the clock is the record: morning; the DM's prose slipped

items.kind: real: a wrong condition with no holder (pinned-trace.md)
items.report: The game says I'm "pinned" and must break free, but nobody has grabbed me. I'm behind the bar with the woman. Who is pinning me?

complaints.why: cinst.1 came from turn.4's footing cost (S4) with the PC as its own holder; no one holds the PC

items.kind: made-up: a clue the DM delivered, doubted
items.report: Did Ivette actually tell me the missing boy's name? I don't think I have it.

complaints.why: turn.2 reveal_clue delivered 'who is missing: Falo Hayfoot'; the PC knows it

items.kind: made-up: a person the DM made
items.report: Who is this warden Vorak? Nobody mentioned a warden at the quay gate, he just appeared out of nowhere.

complaints.why: turn.14 the DM's change new_npc put a gate warden there when the PC arrived

items.kind: made-up: an open OFFER's heading (re-frame plays the DM's turn again)
items.report: The offer is headed "Learn from Kazain Ironhelm", but I'm only asking him quietly to explain the early ledger date. The heading doesn't match what I'm doing.

complaints.why: the OFFER on screen: fixed by re-framing (the DM proposes again) or taking the turn back

items.kind: made-up: a condition the passage ended, with an OFFER open
items.report: The last passage has me heaving myself up out of the mud, but my sheet still says I'm prone.

complaints.why: prone came from turn.8's footing cost; turn.10's passage stands the PC up
